fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for change set 'The import guide's decision' (no owner present). The planner read rhiza guide import step 4 (internal/guide/text/import.md), the import-autonomous-decisions leaf and its testscript, and found no rhiza check code that reads an imported decision's wording. It raised one question covering three choices: which intent the change set serves, the leaf shape, and what 'rhiza check must accept both forms' means. The arbiter decided (import-owner-credited-wording-shape, assumed, would have escalated): serve milestone-27 and m27-nebari-imported; add one new childless leaf beside import-autonomous-decisions under rhiza/guide, giving step 4 a second wording form '<decided>, made by the owner as recorded in <document>' for decisions a document attributes to the owner, both forms with no quote and a derived-from link to the Source; no new check code, the acceptance being a testscript in which both forms land and pass rhiza check. Nothing is left open.
fields.title: Plan of the import guide's decision wording, autonomous
